description:
Discover the Loro Piana Holiday 2026 Campaign, where art de vivre and refined style find harmony.    

For the new season, the Maison travels to the striking winter enclave of Dunton Hot Springs in Colorado. From vast snowfields to the warmth of the wooden chalets, the images move between the expansive and the intimate, casting a sense of timeless winter refinement. In a palette of signature greens, earthy browns, and pure whites, the silhouettes are animated with an interplay of textures with exclusive patterns and elaborate stitches, creating masterful layers that elevate both touch and visual charm. It is also here that the desire for cosy elegance becomes integral to everyday dress, expressed through precious fibres and easy volumes. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaHoliday
title: Loro Piana Holiday 2026 Campaign

description:
Presenting Solutions For, born from a functional way of dressing, shaped by use and experience. 

The House unveils its Spring/Summer 2027 Collection Solutions For in the captivating Biblioteca Nazionale Braidense. Located within the Palazzo di Brera, devoted to the pursuit of learning, it is a testament to the intellectual and artistic life in Milan. The rooms enter into direct dialogue with the collection, bound by a shared dedication to items worthy of study. Drawing from emblematic codes and sensibilities, the silhouettes offer a solution for a specific wardrobe need. Protagonists are archetypes, both new and steeped in the Maison’s history, guided by purpose. A Loro Piana take on the act of dressing, where the functional and the elegant meet.  

#MFW
#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaSS27
title: Loro Piana Spring/Summer 2027 Press Presentation

description:
Unveiling Loro Piana Ghemme, a centre of knitwear excellence in the heart of Piedmont.

Loro Piana opens its new state-of-the-art facility in Ghemme. From yarn to finished product, it encompasses the Maison’s entire production cycle for knitwear in a single location. The region is deeply embedded in the House’s history and home to generations of knitwear experts. With the Roccapietra mill and Quarona plant within strategic reach, this centre reflects the Maison’s dedication to developing its expertise, while preserving its unique knitwear savoir-faire and Made in Italy craftsmanship. Designed with a sense of holism, the site harmoniously blends in with the surrounding landscape, making nature an integral part of the workplace. It also features a dedicated area for discovery where visitors can learn more about Loro Piana Ghemme and the legacy of the House, and is home to the Accademia dei Mestieri, the training and campus soul of Loro Piana Ghemme.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Ghemme Opening

description:
The Loro Piana Fall/Winter 2026-2027 Campaign signs a new chapter in the House’s exploration of unique places with a peculiar cultural relevance.

The Maison’s new collection moves and dialogues with the colours and textures of the de Menil’s cultural landscape, from the Menil Collection to the Rothko Chapel. Shaped by movement, function, and the tactile qualities of Loro Piana fabrics, it is seen in use: a picture where art, style, and daily life dissolve into one another. 
 
#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaFW26

description:
Delving into the timeless elegance of life at sea. 

The Maison has served again as Title Sponsor for the Loro Piana Giraglia Regatta, a highly anticipated event in the Mediterranean sailing calendar. Arranged by the Yacht Club Italiano with the support of the Société Nautique de Saint-Tropez, the regatta spans four days of coastal races as well as a 241-mile offshore course and has attracted sailing connoisseurs and experts from all around the world. It solidifies the House’s values of tradition and performance, beauty and grace, with Pier Luigi Loro Piana and crew returning anew for this year’s experience. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Giraglia 2026

description:
Loro Piana reinforces its links to the world of horse-riding. 

The Maison once again supports the prestigious Concours de Saut International Officiel Piazza di Siena, held from 27th to 31st May. Now in its centenary, the time-steeped equestrian competition is one of Europe’s oldest contests and unfolds in the historical park of Villa Borghese. It is underpinned by a sense of tradition and fair play– values that lie at the core of the House. Competing under the gold-blue banner, the sporting hues of the Maison, are athletes Edwina Tops Alexander, Lorenzo De Luca and Sheikh Khalifa Al Thani,wearing a custom Loro Piana equestrian uniform. Melding beauty and grace, the sport was considered a school of life by Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana, one that teaches respect for the horse, perseverance, and discipline. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Piazza di Siena 2026

description:
Loro Piana cements its connection to the world of sailing. 

The Maison returns to the waters of the Gulf of Naples and Sorrento for Tre Golfi Sailing Week 2026. Now in its 71st edition, held from 5th to 28th May, the competition takes place across the course of three weeks and counts as a foremost offshore racing event in the Mediterranean. Participants are taking on the iconic 150-mile long-distance regatta along with four days of coastal races in an exhibit of skill, refinement, and a passion for the sea. The contest will conclude with the Loro Piana Challenge Trophy, awarded to the winner of the IMA Maxi European Championship, who will keep it until next year. It builds on the House’s position as purveyor of high-performing craftsmanship and timeless design in the field of plein air sports. More than a pastime, sailing is a way of living for the Maison, evoking a deep contact with nature and a dedication to excellence. The deck is also where some of the House’s iconic creations were born, melding tradition with an innovative spirit. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana - Tre Golfi Sailing Week 2026

description:
The Loro Piana Knit Design Award 2026, Knitting Light​ – Craft on the Evolution of Colour.  

The Knit Design Award invites students from leading fashion and design schools from around the world to reinterpret the Maison’s signature yarns. For this year’s edition, circling around the notion of Knitting Light, participants are encouraged to explore the spectrum of Loro Piana’s vibrant nuances and light effects by combining cashmere with an array of special yarns. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the Knit Design Award, highlighting the Maison’s commitment to promoting the designers and knitwear experts of tomorrow. From the debut 2017 edition through to today, the initiative is underpinned by a shared passion for knitwear, inspiring creative and innovative approaches to the House’s signature yarns. Throughout the past decade, the submissions have changed from prototypes to full silhouettes – an evolution that is showcased through a dedicated exhibition at the Galleria Rossana Orlandi in Milan.

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaKnitDesignAward
title: Loro Piana Knit Design Award 2026

description:
Dive into the Loro Piana Resort 2026 Collection.

The Maison’s new collection is the ultimate expression of ease and refinement. Captured amidst vast desert landscapes interspersed with striking cacti and rugged stones, it is an invitation to embrace a quiet, soulful space where time slows down and sophistication meets relaxed style. From the purity of the designs to the vibrancy of the palette and the prints, the collection presents a wardrobe of fluid silhouettes in impalpable summer materials that span light linens and delicate silks. Versatile and sophisticated, the creations are designed to transition seamlessly from the city to sunlit destinations. ​

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaResort2026
title: Loro Piana Resort 2026 Campaign

description:
Studies, Chapter I: On the Plaid, an installation devoted to a central element of the interior vocabulary. ​

For Milan Design Week 2026, Loro Piana introduces the first of a series of case studies focused on a specific object. From the mid-1980s, plaids were among the House’s first finished products, where materials and textile approaches could be explored with creative freedom. Showcased at its Milan headquarters, the display adopts a curatorial language, guiding visitors through a winding path to discover different expressions of the House’s plaid universe. The installation starts with a reference to Valsesia, the Maison’s home, before spotlighting emblematic codes and deep-diving into Loro Piana’s floral repertoire, the world of paisley, and textured abstractions. While differentiated in their techniques, constructions, patterns, and finishes, the plaids form a cohesive index. Approached like couture, they are exclusive creations that reveal a culture of excellence rooted in fibre, craft, and nature.  ​

Explore the exhibition at the Cortile della Seta, at via della Moscova 33, from Tuesday, April 21st, to Sunday, April 26th, from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm. ​

#LoroPiana ​
#MilanDesignWeek
title: Loro Piana Milan Design Week 2026 - "Studies, Chapter 1: On the Plaid"

description:
The Loro Piana Record Bale Award, encapsulating an incessant dedication to excellence in Merino wool fibres. 

This award represents a relentless passion for quality and exclusive fabrics, exemplified by the Australian Record Bale of 92 kg, achieving a finesse of a mere 10.4 microns, as well as the New Zealand Record Bale of 91 kg, measuring at 11.2 microns. This year’s winning bales are presented alongside the 2023 World Record Bale, which set a new Merino wool benchmark of 10.2 microns, achieved by the Pyrenees Park farm. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Record Bale Awards 2025

description:
Watch the Loro Piana Fall/Winter 2026-2027 Collection unfold.

The Maison’s new collection, Nomadic Reverie, transports guests into an immersive setting inspired by the spirit of voyages that leave lasting impressions, sensations, and memories. Set at the Cortile della Seta, at the House’s Milan headquarters, the showcase is experienced through the windows of a train crossing landscapes, following a wandering path. The collection reflects on the idea of the journey with paisley in all forms and hues, a motif that emerged as a central part of the Maison’s collections from the late 1960s, here cloaking fabric walls, garments, and the intricately printed shawls on display. Effortless and precise, the creations retain the impromptu quality of being put together en route and move from lightness to sensory warmth, in a curated palette of ochre, deep browns and reds, signature Tundra, and midnight blue. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaFW26
#MFW
title: Loro Piana Fall/Winter 2026 Press Presentation

description:
Discover the Maison’s latest Excellence, defined by its luminous finesse and featherweight.

Loro Piana Royal Lightness® encapsulates the House’s enduring pursuit of unique materials, embodying weightless elegance, a subtle sheen, and a touch of the exceptional. Spun from Mulberry silk and Merino wool, the knitwear yarn is crafted with extreme precision, skill, and know-how to prevent the threads from breaking. Gossamer and delicate, it achieves novel heights in delicacy, showcasing the Maison’s profound textile knowledge and heritage in fibres. Loro Piana Royal Lightness® is also offered as a fabric.  

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaSavoirFaire
title: Loro Piana Savoir-Faire: Royal Lightness

description:
Discover the elegance of the Loro Piana Ramadan 2026 Capsule Collection.  

The Loro Piana Ramadan 2026 Capsule Collection presents a wardrobe of timeless sophistication. Curated with flowing, loosely structured shapes and elevated accessories to match, it is designed for effortless layering – casting a perfect fusion of lightness, ease, and comfort. At the curation’s core is the Maison’s signature elongated silhouette, defined by clean, simple lines, a sense of impeccable flow, and a palette of soft neutrals and desert tones of sage and sand.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Ramadan 2026 Campaign

description:
Watch Loro Piana deepen its heritage in classic cars at The International Concours of Elegance St. Moritz.
 
From 30th to 31st January, the Maison returns to The International Concours of Elegance St. Moritz, a legendary contest taking place on the frozen lake of St. Moritz. Marking the House’s third year at the iconic competition, its presence reinforces its long-standing fascination and ties with the world of classic cars in a fusion of elegant design, mechanical excellence, and savoir-vivre. The event transforms the traditional concours format into a dynamic ice exhibition that captivates collectors, designers, and enthusiasts from around the world, celebrating beauty and innovation. Loro Piana has curated a dedicated capsule, featuring exclusive iterations of the Roadster jacket and only found at the St. Moritz boutique, to celebrate the concours. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana at the International Concours of Elegance St.Moritz 2026

description:
Dive into the Loro Piana Lunar New Year 2026 Capsule Collection.
 
Curated as an homage to the Year of the Horse, the Maison’s dedicated capsule weaves together a story of togetherness and new beginnings, celebrating the energy, passion, and freedom associated with the horse. It presents a wardrobe rooted in timeless refinement, interpreting the horse and its symbolism through iconic designs and elements – from new versions of the Horsey® jacket through to exclusive prints, imbued with poetry and emotion. With a palette of soft browns, warm creams, and hazy taupes, the creations elegantly combine versatile hues with exquisite fibres for a signature touch and sensory lightness.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Lunar New Year 2026 Campaign

description:
Watch the Loro Piana Spring/Summer 2026 Campaign unfold in refined artistry.

For the new season, the House visits the iconic Colombe d’Or and the Fondation Maeght in Saint-Paul-de-Vence, nestled in the heart of Provence. Replete with history and stories, both are spaces where creatives feel at home, inspiration takes root, and beauty is shared – exuding a certain savoir-vivre that lies at the core of the Maison. Within this living texture of art, Loro Piana’s creations are captured in their effortless flow and elevated appearance, dyed in a curated palette that cements the House’s mastery of colour and of line. Rendered in fine fabrications, the silhouettes come in hues as distinct as their weaves, lending an air of unstudied elegance.

#LoroPiana

description:
A look at the next chapter in Loro Piana’s chronicles, honing the world’s finest fibres. 

Trace the journeys of Pier Luigi Loro Piana, who dedicated his life to sourcing the most precious fibres and transforming them into fabrics of incredible finesse. In Inner Mongolia, he discovered the cashmere goats that would yield the yarn for the Maison’s cloud-soft Baby Cashmere®. His journey continued to Australia and New Zealand, where he encountered Merino sheep of all sorts of hues whose coats would turn into the infinitely precious The Gift of Kings® fabric and Pecora Nera®. Pier Luigi also pushed the boundaries of innovation, inspiring the creation of the high-performing Storm System®. Each fabric gives a glimpse into his vision: to discover the rarest raw materials and honour nature’s gifts with the utmost sophistication, performance, and quality.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Chronicles: Chapter VII - Pier Luigi’s Visionary and Adventurous Spirit

description:
Delve into the Loro Piana Holiday 2025 Campaign.  

The Holiday 2025 Campaign blends creativity with breathtaking nature and timeless elegance in the heart of the Swiss Alps, backdropped by a captivating snow-covered landscape. A new chapter in Loro Piana’s story of artistry, it unfolds inside and around the Grand Chalet, built in 1754 and once the refuge of renowned painter Balthus. Today, it is the home and studio of Balthus’ daughter Harumi Klossowska de Rola and her family, carrying a unique legacy. More than just a residence, it is where heritage, art, and savoir-vivre are in constant conversation between generations. The collection reflects this spirit and is designed for every holiday moment, from the slopes to memorable evening occasions. In precious cashmeres and wools, the silhouettes are effortlessly layered and come accompanied by a curated edit of refined gifts. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaHoliday
title: Loro Piana Holiday 2025 Campaign

description:
Immerse yourself in Loro Piana’s enchanting installation at Bergdorf Goodman.  

Loro Piana’s captivating installation at Bergdorf Goodman celebrates the House’s links to the iconic luxury destination and its decade-spanning fascination with New York – a city that has always held a special place in the Maison’s heart. Animated with rotating globes, the perennial thistle, and wooden characters, the window displays narrate Loro Piana’s history and its far-roaming voyages, from raw fibres to finished product. The installation traces a poetic journey from Mongolia to Quarona, Italy, through to New York and the signature retailer, playfully recounting the House’s quest for uniqueness. Accompanying the exhibits is a selection of exclusive products only found at Bergdorf Goodman, along with a personalisation service for the Grande Unita scarf and the Unito blanket. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana at Bergdorf Goodman

description:
At the 2025 Ryder Cup with Loro Piana.

Loro Piana returns to the Ryder Cup – one of the most prestigious team golfing contests which sees America  against Europe – for the 2025 edition. This year, the competition is taking place at the renowned golfing destination Bethpage Black Course in the US. The House is once again dressing Team Europe in bespoke uniforms that seamlessly blend sophistication and functionality – an honour it has had since 2016. As in previous years, the competition cements the Maison’s long-standing values; its commitment to tradition and perfection, its active elegance, and its tenacious spirit of perseverance. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana at the 2025 Ryder Cup

description:
Delve into the artistry behind the Punti a Maglia collection. 

The Punti a Maglia collection epitomises the art of the table, steeped in Loro Piana’s distinctive savoir-vivre. Crafted in France from Limoges porcelain with a slightly translucent sheen, it comprises an elevated ensemble of perfectly complementing plates, servingware, and accompanying accents. Each is adorned with a rhythmic arrangement of patterns that echo the House’s knitting motif and heritage in fibres. Hand-drawn and then digitised, the motifs are decorated with several layers of pigments to obtain their vibrant colourway, nuanced intricacies, and subtle yet unique variations.

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaSavoirFaire
title: Loro Piana Savoir-Faire: Punti a Maglia

description:
Watch the Spring/Summer 2026 Collection come to life at Palazzo Citterio. 

Loro Piana presents the Spring/Summer 2026 Collection at the 18th-century Palazzo Citterio, a space replete with artistic vibrancy and historic character featuring works by Umberto Boccioni, Carlo Carrà, Giorgio Morandi, Amedeo Modigliani, and Pablo Picasso. The season is defined by a chromatic overture, where the House’s expertise in the definition of hues comes to the fore. Flowing through this setting, the collection is in dialogue with the interiors, with carpeted accents, architectural elements, and paintings from the Jesi Collection creating a refined backdrop. Expressions of vibrancy and mastery over colour remain in firm focus, subtly juxtaposing with the vivid palette of the oeuvres displayed.

Presenting at Palazzo Citterio underscores Loro Piana’s ties to the art world.

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaSS26
#MFW
#GrandeBrera
title: Loro Piana Spring/Summer 2026 Press Presentation

description:
Continuing Loro Piana’s chronicles with Sergio Loro Piana, who unveiled the Maison’s contemporary essence.
 
Marking a new chapter in the Maison’s chronicles, imbued Loro Piana with a modern identity underpinned by his taste for beauty and sophistication. With his impeccable style, hands-on engagement, and passion for the arts, he designed iconic signatures, such as the Voyager and the Spagna. However, his real impact went beyond the beautiful creations and was to do with the distinct taste that the Maison came to be associated with – a taste for timeless elegance, and ultimate luxury. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Chronicles: Chapter VI - Sergio Loro Piana's Creative Genius and Eye For Luxury

description:
The Fall/Winter 2025-2026 Campaign, an emerging picture of artistry and savoir-faire. 

At the crossroad of art, architecture, and mastery, the House’s Fall/Winter 2025-2026 Collection recounts a story of uniqueness and excellence. Set within the artistic enclave once home to Jean Cocteau, the visuals delve into an elevated way of living and unique savoir-vivre – dressing exceptional people in exceptional places. The scenes are backdropped by the vibrant free-hand murals, linking Loro Piana’s craftsmanship with the creative endeavours within the villa.

Villa Santo Sospir, Jean Cocteau, South of France – ©ADAGP-Comité Jean Cocteau 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaFW25
title: Loro Piana Fall/Winter 2025-2026 Campaign

description:
A look at two of the Maison’s defining tastemakers, united by a shared vision. 

In 1980, brothers Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took the reins of their father’s business, guiding the Maison into a new era of excellence. Where Sergio Loro Piana emerged as a true visionary of style – with a passion for the minutest details of each garment –, Pier Luigi Loro Piana travelled the globe in search of the most precious raw materials, most notably Baby Cashmere and The Gift of Kings® wool, today synonymous with Loro Piana. Together, the two brothers honoured their family’s heritage while solidifying the legacy of a now-iconic Maison. It is this forward-spurring spirit that continues to drive the Maison today. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Chronicles: Chapter V - The Two Brothers

description:
A quest for ultimate excellence.  

Cashmere epitomises Loro Piana’s unwavering pursuit of quality – evoking visions of sumptuous softness and fascinating tales of distant lands. For over 40 years, the House has established itself as the historical advocate for cashmere excellence, working in close collaboration with herders and local partners.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Piana Savoir-Faire: Cashmere

description:
A new chapter in the making of a Maison, defined by a pioneering spirit.
 
A closer look at Franco Loro Piana, who revolutionised the Maison’s approach to textiles and elevated it into the global spotlight. Taking over the helm in 1949, he kindled relationships with prestigious couturiers and started supplying high-quality fabrics and textile innovations to the most renowned houses in France, laying the base for Loro Piana’s world-renowned reputation. A closer look at  Franco’s passion for sourcing the finest raw materials highlights how he took Loro Piana to new heights. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Chronicles: Chapter IV - Franco's Pioneering Spirit

description:
Loro Piana’s connection to the sea is deep – it is where some of the Maison’s most iconic silhouettes were born, each a beacon of exquisite craftsmanship and timeless style. Much like an open-air laboratory, the world of sailing has inspired the House’s artisans to reinvent signature shapes and materials through a quintessential Loro Piana lens, resulting in incredibly refined pieces that are primed for ultimate performance. 

This year, Loro Piana once again returns to the Giraglia Regatta as Title Sponsor. Organised by the Yacht Club Italiano with the support of the Société Nautique de Saint-Tropez, the regatta is one of the most important events in top-level Mediterranean sailing, with coastal races held over the course of four days from 7th to 10th June. Starting in Saint-Tropez and moving to Genoa via the Giraglia rock in Northern Corsica, the Loro Piana Giraglia 2025 is a voyage of 241 nautical miles – a significant moment that echoes the House’s values of tradition, fair play, and ultimate performance. Off the shore, in Saint-Tropez, the terrace-fronted Loro Piana Giraglia Lounge and Race Village overlook the iconic port of the city, creating an enveloping and inviting ambiance. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Giraglia 2025

description:
Honouring an incessant dedication to ultimate excellence in Merino fibres. 

The Loro Piana Record Bale Award rewards two farms – one in Australia and one in New Zealand – that successfully produce the finest bale of Merino wool, with special credits going to the Australian farm Pyrenees Park, which produced a Merino fibre of a mere 10.5 microns. Taking place at the San Francisco City Hall on 28th May, the award ceremony is hosted by Loro Piana CEO Damien Bertrand and Pier Luigi Loro Piana, Deputy Chairman of the Maison, and a pioneer and supporter of the ongoing quest for the finest Merino wool. With finesses that vary infinitesimally, the extraordinary results achieved by the breeders reflect their unwavering commitment to producing ever-finer and better-performing wool.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Record Bale Award

description:
Discover Loro Piana’s long-standing relationship with the equestrian world. 

Underpinned by its commitment to elegance and excellence in sports, the House returns to Rome for this year’s Concours de Saut International Officiel Piazza di Siena, one of Europe’s oldest equestrian competitions. Now in its 92nd edition, held in the historical park of Villa Borghese from 22nd to 25th May, the event strengthens the values of tradition, fair play, and a love of nature that Loro Piana shares with the equestrian world. In honour of the House’s sponsorship, two courses are named after the Maison: the Loro Piana Trophy and the Loro Piana Six-Bars. The House has also equipped riders with an exclusive equestrian uniform, designed to blend elegant style with supreme comfort and ultimate performance. 

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana Piazza di Siena 2025

description:
Discover Loro Piana’s ties to the world of sailing. 

Looking back onto a passion for sailing and seaside sophistication, the Maison is participating in the eagerly awaited Tre Golfi Sailing Week 2025 as sponsor. Held from 17th to 22nd May off the coast of Sorrento, Italy, the event is one of the most prestigious in the Mediterranean and will comprise a 150-mile long-distance regatta and four days of coastal races. At the end of the event the House will award the Loro Piana Challenge Trophy to the winner of IMA Maxi European Championship, who will keep it until the next edition. The House’s passion for sailing showcases its dedication to an effortless and sophisticated lifestyle at sea, through tradition, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. It is on deck where the most iconic of creations were conceived – from the White Sole, designed to leave the deck spotless, to the Bomber in Windmate® inspired by sailing cloth. The water-bound pastime is portrayed as more than a mere sport – it is a discerning way of living, replete with a joyful savoir-vivre.

#LoroPiana
title: Loro Piana - Tre Golfi Sailing Week 2025

description:
Meet a new generation of designers at the Loro Piana Knit Design Award 2025. 

Now in its 9th edition, the Knit Design Award invites international students to present their creative interpretations of the House’s iconic yarns that epitomise a legacy in textile excellence. Circling around the theme of a Winter Legacy through the lens of the perennial linen fibre, the participants play with texture, colours, and techniques and create their very own take on heirloom knitwear. The winners are honoured with the Knit Design Award 2025 prize as well as a scholarship and a unique career opportunity to delve into the knitwear excellence of the Maison. Since 2016, this initiative has engaged talents from the world’s most prestigious fashion design schools – supporting a new generation of designers and transmitting the House’s knitwear expertise and savoir-faire. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaKnitDesignAward
title: Loro Piana Knit Design Award 2025

description:
Designed for enjoyment in nature’s refuge. 

Tracing the wanderings of a group of curious individuals, the Resort 2025 Collection explores the new frontiers of tailoring and presents a comfortable and sophisticated wardrobe. Inspiration is drawn from the details and colours of the incredible surroundings – a picture of beauty and intricacy, timelessness and relevance. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaResort2025
title: Loro Piana Resort 2025 Campaign

description:
Step into La Prima Notte di Quiete, an immersive experience presented by Loro Piana and Dimoremilano.

To mark this year’s Milan Design Week, Loro Piana and Dimoremilano debut together to present La Prima Notte di Quiete, a captivating experience that unfolds, like a film, at the Cortile della Seta courtyard in the Maison’s Milan headquarters. Once welcomed in a vintage-cinema foyer, visitors get to watch a fully furnished Loro Piana house come to life, where the boundaries between reality and fiction vanish. The installation unfolds across an entrance, three rooms, and a garden, blending sophisticated design with unparalleled craftsmanship. Exceptional furniture designed by Emiliano Salci and Britt Moran for Loro Piana Interiors, along with pieces from Dimoremilano, Loro Piana’s The Art of Good Living Collection, and antiques punctuate the rooms – complete with special light and sound animations to accent the style and elegance of the details. More than a mere space, it is an invitation to engage with the finest in both design, comfort, and sumptuous luxury. 

#LoroPiana
#SaloneDelMobile
#MilanDesignWeek
#LoroPianaInteriors
title: Loro Piana and Dimoremilano for Milan Design Week 2025 - “La Prima Notte Di Quiete”

description:
Delve into Loro Piana’s legacy in cashmere, a search for ultimate excellence. 

From the 1960s when Franco Loro Piana began producing cashmere garments to today, the House’s cashmere is steeped in heritage, an unwavering dedication to quality, and close relationships with herders from Inner Mongolia. The precious raw material has come to encapsulate the House’s mastery in fibres – testifying to the beauty of the precious animals as well as the efforts and commitment of local herders. Over the years, Loro Piana has reaffirmed its quest for excellence through special projects, most notably the Cashmere of the Year Award. Encouraging farmers to elevate the quality of their fibres to unfathomable finesse, this special initiative unveils the Maison’s holistic approach to refinement while placing every person in the production process en par, part of a unique chain of hands. 

#LoroPiana
#LoroPianaSavoirFaire
title: Loro Piana Savoir-Faire: Cashmere

description:
Discover Loro Piana’s first-ever exhibition If You Know, You Know. Loro Piana’s Quest for Excellence.

On the occasion of its 100-year anniversary and as a tribute to its deep, long-standing connection to China, Loro Piana presents its first-ever exhibition at the Museum of Art Pudong (MAP) in Shanghai, which, for the first time, hosts a luxury House. Curated by Judith Clark, the retrospective offers an immersive journey through Loro Piana’s heritage, chronicled through a captivating tapestry of archival documents, artworks, garments, and more. With a focus on exceptional savoir-faire and mastery in fibres and fabrics, the exhibition uncovers a masterful chain of hands that creates the finest dreams while celebrating the House’s long-standing ties to China, where it sources its iconic Cashmere from. The retrospective coincides with the award ceremony of the Loro Piana Cashmere of the Year Award, held during a gala dinner at the MAP in honour of those who dedicate their lives to producing the world’s most precious fibres – a core value of the Maison.

description:
Loro Piana’s Pecora Nera® wool, the revival of the dark Merino. 

Pecora Nera® is a story of embracing the beauty in the margins, finding luxury in the different, and ultimately touching the exceptional in life. 

Once upon a time, sheep existed in a variety of natural colours, from the cream colour we know so well through various shades of beige, brown, and black. Yet with time, mankind wilfully bred the darker-hued sheep out, leaving them to become a sight both rare and unpopular – an anti-hero of sorts.

Where most farmers looked away, one fell madly in love. Her name is Fiona Gardner, an English expatriate who made New Zealand her home and these unwanted black lambs her family. Knowing there was something refined about the wool, she went on to source far and wide, lending her flock of Merino sheep the genetic advantage of hybrid vigour so that each generation was able to produce a higher quality fibre. Once content with the fibre quality, she searched for someone who would understand its rarity and reveal its particular beauty as they transformed it into clothing. That someone was Pier Luigi Loro Piana, one of the grandsons of Pietro Loro Piana, bringing the Maison’s masterful way with fibres with him. And so, Pecora Nera® was born.

Over the years, the precious wool has been honed to ultimate perfection, with shades of black, grey, and brown that embrace the full spectrum of natural hues. Dark-hued, undyed, and daringly different, it is the result of skilful craftsmanshi

description:
The thistle flower, a symbol of the Maison’s savoir-faire and textile legacy. 

Emblematic of the link between nature and craftsmanship, the thistle flower, “fiori di cardo” in Italian, was historically used as a tool to raise and brush the surface of precious fabrics in the Loro Piana Quarona factory in Piedmont. Thanks to its curved tips, it would lend materials a sublime finish – soft, lustrous, and delicate all at once – and has been part of  the House’s historical coat of arms since 1951. The competition invites international students to offer their own creative interpretations of some of the most iconic yarns that epitomise the excellence of the House. 

Pierre Sauvageot and Björn Backes with their Professor François-Xavier Herody from École Duperré are the winners of the Loro Piana Knit Design Award 2024! 
 
The winning project “Cavalieri, A History Of Innovation” draws inspiration from the noble lineage of ancient knights, reimagining the application of Loro Piana yarns by crafting a cashmere armour. description:
Vicuña is one of the rarest and most precious fibres in the world, taken from the exceptional breed found in the Andes. The clothing creations in vicuña represent the essence of Loro Piana, as this most precious of fabrics is cultivated and expertly crafted into exquisite garments.

An item in vicuña is a lightweight, soft and natural garment, that conveys the exclusivity of this rare textile fibre.

description:
The initiative which was first launched back in 2016 is an international competition that aims to give talented design students the chance to showcase their unique creative expressions on some of Loro Piana's iconic yarns.

The Brief for 2023 was, “Regenerate”, adding an innovative Touch; perfectly captured by Blake Dewitt and Sumin An from Fashion Institute of Technology. Guided by Professor Thomas Scott, the students presented a project with the incorporation of Loro Piana yarns with a vintage chair.  The Fashion Institute of Technology is the winner of the Knit Design Award 7th edition.

description:
During the Milan Fashion Week, for the first time, Métiers D’Excellence LVMH held the “Premio Maestri d’Eccellenza” Award.

The initiative is dedicated to Italian artisans with the aim of raising awareness towards the importance of craftsmanship’s tradition and transmitting our unique savoir-faire.
The winners were experienced artisans, emerging talents and professionals who stood out for their ability to combine innovation with heritage.
